title: Knox County, Missouri -- Pay Property Taxes
text:
Knox County, Missouri -- Pay Property Taxes
Knox County Collector's Office
Pay Property Taxes Online
For your convenience, you may pay your Knox County, Missouri real estate and
personal property taxes online. A convenience fee may be charged for the use
of this service and will be automatically calculated, if applicable.
Our payment processor requires you to choose one of the following Bureau Codes,
depending on whether you are paying real estate or personal property taxes:
Personal Property Taxes 3487693
Real Estate Taxes 9883334
Merchant's License Fees 3915604
